Ambassador Programme

Build your own business in health and nutrition

What you can build

Your business, in the shape that fits you

From a nutrition club like Boost Club to your own concept. The model adapts to your interest.

Nutrition club

A place like Boost Club: consultations, community, shakes. This is the model you learn directly from the inside.

Fit / nutrition café

A neighbourhood spot with products and drinks built around a healthy lifestyle.

Gym or fit club

Training plus nutrition under one roof, for people passionate about sport.

Your own concept

Do business with friends, around your own idea. The partner community helps you build it.

Ambassador Programme + Boost Club

Learn inside a business that already works

You don't start from zero and you don't learn from manuals. You join Boost Club, a working nutrition club with real clients, and learn every part of the business from the inside, as a partner.

Already a Boost Club client with results of your own? Even better. You start with a real advantage. If not, no problem: you learn everything in the programme.

How you learn

The "do to learn" philosophy

No endless theory and no rigid timelines. You do from the start and you learn exactly what you do.

1

Send your request

Choose whether you want to start part-time or full-time. Gabriel receives your request and contacts you for a first conversation.

2

Observation through practice

From day one you do, you don't just watch: you take part in consultations, work with the community, and learn how the club runs. Gabriel is beside you to help you learn and do everything at your own pace, with no fixed deadlines.

3

Build

With the support of a global community of partners who teach, collaborate and build together, from your first client to your own club.

Why this model

Real freedom, real work

No boss

Nobody tells you what to do. You work how you want, when you want, from wherever you want. You build your own schedule.

Income reflects your work

What you build is yours. Your income is directly tied to your effort, consistency and skills.

Grow with people

Do business alongside friends and a community that pushes you forward and develop yourself along the way.

The Ambassador Programme is educational and entrepreneurial. Earnings are not guaranteed and depend on effort, skills and fit. For details, see the official Statement of Typical Earnings of Herbalife Independent Distributors.

How you begin.

We start with an initial consultation, on WhatsApp or video. We go over your goals, how you'd want to build, and whether this is the right fit for you before anything else.

THEN

We build your version of the system

Operate under the Boost Club name in your location, or create something with its own identity. Both are possible. It's your business, after all.

AFTER

You launch, the team stays with you

You operate within a proven system, and the team, led by Gabriel Neshto, stays engaged to help you reach your full potential.

Two ways to build

With a location. Or fully online.

A nutrition club, like ours.

The flagship model is a location in your city, built on the Boost Club system. It includes a morning community, clients who come back daily and a physical place people call their own. It's the main path described on this page.

One address, one communityA daily ritualRecurring local income

Don't want to be tied to a physical location?

You can build your business fully online: wellness marathons, 21-day challenges, remote coaching and communities. The same clients, the same method and the same mentorship, with no rent or address. Some operators start online and open a location later. Others stay online. Both are real businesses.

Wellness marathons21-day challengesClients from any countryWork from anywhere
Start your online business →
How the money works

Where your income comes from.

Main source · one

The clients you serve

You earn a margin on the products your clients buy and reorder each month. It's recurring, and it tracks directly with how many people you look after, and how well.

+
Main source · two

The people you develop

Once you're established, you can earn from the volume built by people you help start and coach. The team supports you in the same way now.

And, for those who qualify
Annual performance bonuses

Atypical achievements came from hard work, skill and dedication. For more, see hrbl.me/STE_WW.

There's no ceiling on what you can earn here. What you build is what you earn. It comes down entirely to you.

The real numbers depend on your country and your situation.

Talk numbers with Gabi →
What ownership changes

The point isn't a number on a screen. It's control over your time, your ceiling, and where you do it from.

You decide your hours, choose your clients, and set how far you take it. Because the model operates in dozens of countries, it isn't tied to one desk or one city. Some operators run it from a different country than the one they started in. Clients who reorder create recurring revenue, so consistent work compounds rather than resetting to zero each month like a wage.

And it's open to everyone. It doesn't matter where you begin, what you studied, or what you did before. People from every background have built something real here. What it rewards is patience and consistency, and that's within reach of anyone willing to show up for it.

Skip to main content {{shared-header}}
Legal

Privacy Policy

Last updated: September 2026

1. Controller

Gabriel Neshto, Boost Club, Strada Sevastopol 24, Sector 1, Bucharest. Contact: gneshto@gmail.com, +40 726 205 752.

2. Data we collect

Via the booking form

Name, phone number, the date and time you choose (or your preferred day and time window), main wellness goal, language and an optional message. For the Partner Program we also ask for your country. With each request we store the page you sent it from and how you found us (for example, a campaign link). We use this data solely to confirm and manage your consultation or request.

Bioimpedance data (at the consultation)

Body composition results (muscle mass, fat mass, water, visceral fat, metabolic age) are special-category health data under GDPR Article 9. We process them only with your explicit consent, given verbally at the time of the consultation, and solely for the purpose of explaining your results and personalising our recommendations.

Analytics cookies

Only with your consent (via the cookie banner): anonymised visitor statistics via Google Analytics 4 (IP masked).

3. Legal bases for processing

  • Booking form data: legitimate interest (confirming and managing the free consultation)
  • Bioimpedance data: explicit consent (Article 9(2)(a) GDPR)
  • Analytics cookies: consent

4. Data retention

Booking form data: 12 months or until you request deletion. Bioimpedance data: retained only for the duration of the coaching relationship or until you request deletion. Analytics data: 14 months (Google Analytics default).

5. Your rights

Under GDPR you have the right to: access your data, rectify it, erase it ("right to be forgotten"), restrict or object to processing, and data portability. To exercise any of these rights, email gneshto@gmail.com. We will respond within 30 days.

6. Third parties

We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes. Form submissions are processed by Netlify (USA, Standard Contractual Clauses apply). Bookings and consultation history are stored in Supabase, our database provider, and appointments are scheduled in Google Calendar; both act only on our behalf. If you message us or we confirm your booking on WhatsApp, messages pass through WhatsApp (Meta) under its own privacy policy. Analytics data is processed by Google (USA, Standard Contractual Clauses apply) only with your consent.

7. Supervisory authority

You have the right to lodge a complaint with the Romanian National Supervisory Authority for Personal Data Processing (ANSPDCP): www.dataprotection.ro.

Cookie Policy

Last updated: June 2026

What are cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored in your browser when you visit a website. They allow the site to remember certain preferences or to function correctly.

Cookies we use

TypePurposeRequires consent?
Strictly necessaryOperation of the booking form, browsing session, basic securityNo, required for operation
PreferencesRemembering navigation preferences (e.g. menu open/closed)No, functional, no tracking
Analytics (Google Analytics)Anonymised visitor statistics, how many people visit the site, which pages are popularYes, activated only with your consent
Marketing / advertisingTracking for personalised adsWe do not use such cookies

Google Analytics

If you consent, we use Google Analytics 4 to understand how the site is used. Data is anonymised (IP masked) and does not identify individuals. You can opt out at any time via your browser cookie settings or the official Google Analytics Opt-out add-on.

How to control cookies

You can manage or delete cookies from your browser settings:

  • Mozilla Firefox

Skip to main content {{shared-header}}
Your free visit

What happens at your visit

30–40 structured, clear and pressure-free minutes. Here's exactly what to expect from your first visit to Boost Club.

Book your free assessment
Before you arrive

Before you arrive

No special preparation needed. A few simple tips for the most accurate results.

Normal hydration

Drink water normally on the day of your visit. Avoid alcohol or excessive fluid intake a few hours before. These can affect the measurement.

Comfortable clothes

Come in light, comfortable clothing. No sportswear needed. The consultation doesn't involve training.

Allow 40 minutes

The session takes 30–40 minutes. Don't rush. The most valuable moment is the discussion after the measurement.

Step by step

Step by step. What happens

💬

1 · Brief conversation

Gabriel welcomes you and we learn where you're starting and what you want to change. It takes 5 relaxed minutes.

⚖️

2 · Body analysis

Gabriel explains each step of the bioimpedance measurement. Contact the club before your visit for preparation instructions specific to the device.

📊

3 · Results, explained

You get the full report, translated into plain language, not just numbers on paper.

🎯

4 · Your goal

We talk about what you want: weight loss, muscle or energy. No templates.

✅

5 · A clear first step

You leave with one concrete, achievable next step. No pressure. Your call.

What you'll learn

What you'll find out about your body

The professional analyser measures more than weight. You get real data to understand and use.

💪
Muscle massHow much muscle you have and how it's distributed
🔥
Fat massBody-fat percentage and whether it's in a healthy range
💧
Body waterYour hydration level
🫀
Visceral fatFat around your organs, key to metabolic health
⏳
Metabolic ageHow efficiently your metabolism works
⚡
Metabolic rateCalories you burn at rest, the basis of any plan
Guidance

What kind of guidance you'll receive

Everyone leaves with recommendations tailored to their goal and routine, not generic advice.

Eating habits

Practical guidance on balanced nutrition that fits your real lifestyle, not an ideal plan that's impossible to follow.

Daily structure

Suggestions on meal frequency, hydration and micro-habits that support your goal without disrupting your schedule.

Movement and activity

General recommendations on the type and frequency of physical activity suited to you, regardless of your current fitness level.

Concrete next step

One clear action you can take in the coming week. Not an overwhelming list. One achievable step.

First step

Ready to see where you stand?

Book your free body assessment and leave with a clear plan.

The story, in short

I built my own body first. Then a club.

I started out underweight, without structure and with confidence near zero. Proper nutrition and consistent training added over 20 kg of muscle and showed me that results don't come from information, but from a system, simplicity and people beside you.

Today I compete as a semi-pro MMA fighter and track athlete, and the discipline from the ring is the same one I bring to the club: measurable steps, executed consistently, no shortcuts.

I'm the third generation of a family working in wellness since 1989. My family has guided thousands of people across dozens of countries. Boost Club, at Sevastopol 24, is where all that experience comes home.

"Information alone isn't enough. You need a system, simplicity and people beside you. That changed everything for me and it's exactly what I'm building for my clients."

Gabi Neshto · Founder
How I work

Three rules, in this order.

01Client results first.

A plan, a room and people who expect you to show up. Progress is measured, not promised.

02Business second.

The opportunity exists and it's visible, but discreet. The work speaks first; those who want to build, ask.

03Standards always.

No hype, no exaggerated promises, no shortcuts. What I wouldn't accept for myself never reaches clients.

Two paths

Come as a client. Or build with me.

Boost Club founder

Gabriel Neshto

ISSA-accredited consultant, semi-professional MMA fighter and track & field athlete, third generation of a family with 36 years in wellness, and someone who built his own body from zero: over 20 kg of muscle.

I don't sell you a perfect plan. I offer a realistic direction, built around your life, not the other way around.

Book a consultation with Gabriel
ISSA accredited +20 kg of muscle Semi-pro MMA fighter Clients from 20+ countries
My story

My story, unfiltered: where I started, what I went through, and how I got to where I am today.

ISSAAccredited consultant

20+Countries
Credentials

Why you can trust him

🎓

ISSA accredited

International certification from the International Sports Sciences Association, backed by years of systematic study in sports science, nutrition and health.

🥊

Competing athlete

Over 20 kg of muscle built through proper nutrition and training. Competes as a semi-professional MMA fighter and track & field athlete.

🌿

36 years of heritage

The Neshto family has worked in wellness for 36 years and guided thousands of people. Gabriel grew up in this environment and carries the tradition forward.

🌍

International community

Clients from over 20 countries, from France, Switzerland and the UK to the USA, India and Singapore. Close to 30,000 followers online.

The story

Gabriel's journey

1

The starting point

Underweight, living chaotically, with close to zero confidence.

2

The change

Proper nutrition + structured training → over 20 kg of muscle.

3

Sport

Today he competes as a semi-pro MMA fighter and track & field athlete.

4

The training

Years studying sports science and nutrition, confirmed by the ISSA certification.

5

Boost Club

All that experience comes home to Bucharest. You come in, measure your start, leave with a clear direction.

"Information alone is not enough. You need a system, simplicity, and people beside you. That changed everything for me and it's exactly what I build for my clients today."

Gabriel Neshto
Sport & community

From the ring and the track, into the club

The discipline of MMA and athletics is the same discipline Gabriel brings to consultations: measurable steps, executed consistently, no shortcuts.

Close to 30,000 people follow him on social media, where his content on nutrition, training and lifestyle has gathered millions of views.

@gabineshto on Instagram gabrielneshto.com
Family heritage

36 years of wellness. A tradition that continues

The Neshto family has worked in nutrition and wellness since 1989. Over these decades, they have guided thousands of people of all ages, with all types of goals. Gabriel is the natural continuation of this tradition, with a younger, more modern perspective closer to the pace of life today.

This means that behind Boost Club stands not an entrepreneur who read a few books, but a family that has seen what works on thousands of real people, in real time, for nearly four decades.

Philosophy

The 3 S philosophy: Systems, Simplicity, Support

Health doesn't run on willpower. It runs on three things built correctly.

Systems

On a busy day, a simple plan can make choices easier. Together, we look for habits you can fit into your daily routine.

Simplicity

If your "healthy" breakfast takes an hour in the morning, half-asleep, plus a mountain of dishes, you'll end up doing neither. What's simple gets done. What's complicated gets postponed.

Support

The best students in the world have teachers. The best athletes have coaches. The best doctors have mentors. Yet most people think health is something to figure out alone. News flash: you don't have to.

First step

Come and meet us

The first consultation is free, no obligations, and takes 30–40 minutes. You leave with real data and a clear next step.
